audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields say Spirit's Refuge 'blanks your poke'. It does not — Riot's text is that it blocks ATTACKS that would hit Shen or his allies near the spirit blade. Your abilities pass straight through.
audit.why: A player told the zone blanks their poke will stop casting into it and hand Shen free waves. The truth is the opposite: keep casting Twofold Hex and The Weirding through Spirit's Refuge and only withhold autos. Numbers that make it concrete: Spirit's Refuge is 16s at rank 1 down to 10s, Shadow Dash is 18s down to 10s at 600 range, and Stand United is 200/180/160.
audit.corrected: 'Blanks your poke' replaced with the attacks-only rule in the late-game text and the late spike; cooldown block rebuilt on the real numbers.

edits.before: Shen reclaims it: his Q-empowered autos shred you through your passive heals and his W zone blanks your poke, so one taunt past your W reset deletes a squishy mage.
edits.after: Shen reclaims it: Twilight Assault's max-HP autos shred through your passive heals. Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, so keep casting Q and E through it — just never auto.

notes: The _missing file claims Between Worlds cancels Stand United because Stand United is a channel. Riot's text for Between Worlds gives a shockwave that damages and slows — a slow does not interrupt a channel — so I did not write that claim anywhere. Listed as unverified. Also: 'Between Worlds makes you untargetable' recurs across Aurora's entries and is not in Riot's text; the invisibility is on Across the Veil.
